profile.summary: Tirupati Forge Limited produces and sells carbon steel forged flanges, forged, and other automotive components in India. The company provides slip-on, weld-neck, blind, lap-joint, threaded, din, and socket weld flanges; and elbow, tee, cross, coupling, half coupling, cap, plug, bushing, union, hex, nipple, and swag nipple forged pipe fittings. It also offers forged auto parts, gears, hammer unions
